title: geo.json — 4D spatial graph of a campaign (living world)
description: Source of truth for the spatial graph of a MJ Tonnerre campaign (contract §5, doc 01 §2-4). Three layers: containment (parent), adjacency (edges), anchoring (ancrage {x,y}, code-only, NEVER exposed to LLM). Generated by geo_query.py build (containment from universe.regions, adjacency from rules.time.movements, anchoring via MDS SMACOF stdlib). Anchor coordinates are non-metric (1 unit ~ 1 UT of movement). Non-destructive file: it NEVER writes to world.json. Tolerant (additionalProperties:true): only reports actual gaps.

echelle.description: Note on anchor scale (non-metric, code usage only).

locations.description: Graph nodes. At least one root region (parent null).

lieu.description: Location node of the graph (contract §5.1). Frozen hierarchical id 'type:kebab-path' (contract §2.2).

name.description: Free name for narration (e.g. 'Cabane de Berthe').

parent.description: id of containing location (containment), or null for a root region.

type.description: Nature of the location. Extensible enum: the frozen list from contract §5.1 is advised, but any label is tolerated (additionalProperties spirit).

altitude.description: Optional scalar 'z' (z is managed 95% by containment). null if not set.

aretes.description: Directed adjacency. Can be [] for a root region. Treated BIDIRECTIONALLY by algorithms (outbound = inbound).

ancrage.description: Coarse MDS coordinates (x,y). CODE USAGE ONLY — never seen or produced by LLM (invariant 01 §C / contract §14.2).

arete.description: Directed adjacency edge (contract §5.2). temps_ut inferred from rules.time.movements via minutes_vers_ut(parser_duree_minutes).

vers.description: id of target location (must exist in 'locations').

distance_m.description: Distance in meters if known, otherwise null.

temps_ut.description: Travel duration in UT (≥ 1). 1 UT = 10 min.

voie.description: Route description (derived from narrative duration). Optional.
